text:
leah: Heads up — legal asked whether we can gate audit-log exports for privileged routing changes. They want proof of who pulled full snapshots and a retention policy for presigned links.

kyle: Gate how? presigned link + entitlement check? or do you mean requiring a justification field on request? :thinking_face:

leah: Both. Require an export_reason + requested_by metadata, and don't serve full snapshot presigned links without an approval flag. Default to sampling for large tenants.

jess: +1 on sampling default. Our parquet builder blows up on huge orgs right now, and it spikes mem use.

kyle: Implementation idea: export service runs quota check -> decide mode (sample|full) -> if full and sensitive, create approval ticket and only generate presigned bundle after approval. Fallback: stream NDJSON to webhook for consumers.

michael: From console side, if we sample we still need to show "who changed what" in the timeline. The timeline expects a compact diff anchor; we shouldn't break that.

leah: UX proposal: show compact changelist inline with actor badges and a "download full evidence" CTA that triggers the approval flow. For sampled exports show sampling rate and a link to the sampled query.

jess: We also need actor_provenance mapping in the export payload — SSO renames and service accounts are causing orphaned actor ids in downstream SIEMs.

kyle: API sketch:
```json
{
  "export_id": "uuid",
  "requested_by": "leah@redwood.ai",
  "export_reason": "legal_request_2026-03-21",
  "scope": "tenant:acme-corp",
  "mode": "sample|full",
  "actor_provenance": {
    "actor_id": "user:123",
    "aliases": ["leah", "l.roberts"]
  }
}
```

opsbot: Export job queued: export_id=8d7f-queued tenant=acme-corp mode=sample eta=90s

jess: Also add telemetry: export_request_count, export_mode_breakdown, export_bytes, export_failures, export_approval_latency. We need an SLO for approval turnaround on privileged exports.

michael: I'll add those metrics. For console observability we should add a per-export trace id to link logs + trace to the UI.

kyle: Operational notes: presigned link expiry default 24h, but require re-auth for sensitive exports; also rate-limit per-tenant to 1 full export / 24h by default. Allow enterprise override via Dedicated contracts.

leah: Sounds good. Can we run this by security & legal tomorrow? 10:00am PT sync?

kyle: SGTM. I'll prepare the API PR + a short console mock for the CTA flow.

jess: I'll add backpressure safeguards in the parquet worker and a sampling fallback.

leah: Thanks — adding agenda: API shape, approval flow, telemetry, console CTA, quota defaults.

kyle: tagging @michael to pick up telemetry + console traces.

michael: on it.

leah: closing — follow-up thread after the sync for action items. :white_check_mark:
